We’re looking for a Civil Designer (Civil 3D or 12D) to join our national team based in Melbourne.
Engineering for People, Place, Legacy.
Since 1958, TTW has been solving complex engineering problems for the people and places they serve. We're Australian owned, and we've grown by staying true to the quality work, honest relationships, and a genuine commitment to our clients and communities.
Our strength is our people. We support talented engineers to do their best work, and we invest in helping them grow. That's how we've earned our reputation for smart, sustainable engineering solutions across the sectors we know best.
Our Opportunity
We’re looking for a Civil Designer (Civil 3D or 12D) to join our national team based in Melbourne. In this role you will work across diverse, project-based assignments as part of a collaborative national team. The position of Civil Engineering Designer performs civil engineering technical tasks ranging from medium to high complexity. Designers will work independently or be responsible for leading a team of designers and CAD draftspersons to deliver quality detailed engineering models and drawings, in an efficient manner. The Civil Designer will also work within project design parameters, approved by the project director and\or project design manager.
Additionally, in this role you will
 - Assist project teams in Civil Engineering design, project management and in defining design parameters 
 - Development of civil engineering models in accordance with defined design parameters. 
 - Manage and mentor other civil engineering designers throughout project life cycles.
 - Resolve complex civil engineering design problems.
 - Undertake design checks in accordance with design parameters.   
 - Communicate all design components effectively and accurately with project teams.
Who we are looking for
 - Bachelor of Engineering or Technical College qualification (Advance Diploma Civil Engineering or approved equivalent)
 - Demonstrated experience (at least 5-7+ years) in a similar role
 - Comprehensive understanding of Civil Engineering, including a strong knowledge of Roads, Stormwater Drainage and Earthworks Design. 
 - Competency in Autodesk Civil 3D software.
 - Ability to develop Civil 3D Surfaces, Pipes and Earthworks Models to TTW national standardised frameworks. 
 - Ability to coordinate in ground infrastructure in accordance with relevant authorities.
 - Ability to read and implement local state standards. 
What will make you stand out
 - Highly developed communication skills to effectively communicate and coordinate with project team, clients, stakeholders, authorities, consultants, and contractors. 
 - A team player that works seamlessly with all levels of staff.
 - Highly developed written and verbal communication skills.
 - Problem solving/analytical skills with a great attention to detail.
Why Join TTW?
Our people are what make TTW who we are. We focus on giving you an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally.
Here's what that looks like:
 - Flexible working arrangements
 - A strong focus on work-life balance
 - Health and wellbeing initiatives
 - Ongoing learning and professional development opportunities
 - Career progression within a collaborative global team
 - Exposure to diverse and challenging engineering projects
TTW is committed to fostering a work environment that is inclusive, supports flexibility, and welcomes diversity. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

- Coordinate with internal disciplines and external stakeholders on interfaces (services coordination, site constraints, constructability).
- Provide day-to-day support and informal guidance to graduates/entry-level engineers (as appropriate).
Qualifications

- 2–5 years’ post-graduate experience in civil/site infrastructure design.
- Exposure to applying Austroads and local council/authority requirements (or a willingness to learn quickly).
- Developing competency in stormwater (pit and pipe) and familiarity with earthworks and basic water/wastewater design tasks.
- Interest in WSUD principles and how they integrate with stormwater solutions (a plus).

candidates.content_text:
About the role
EI Australia is seeking a Civil Engineer to contribute to the planning, design and delivery of civil engineering projects. The successful candidate will support project delivery from investigation and concept development through to detailed design, documentation and construction support, working collaboratively with clients, contractors, consultants and multidisciplinary teams to deliver practical, compliant and high-quality outcomes.
Key responsibilities
- Undertake civil engineering design and analysis for relevant infrastructure and land development projects, as appropriate to project requirements.
- Prepare engineering calculations, design drawings, specifications, scopes of work, reports and other technical documentation.
- Contribute to the design of civil infrastructure such as earthworks, pavements, access roads, drainage and stormwater systems, and associated site works where relevant to the project portfolio.
- Review survey information, site constraints, existing services and other project inputs to inform design development.
- Coordinate and liaise with clients, contractors, authorities, consultants and internal disciplines to resolve design issues and communicate technical advice.
- Support site inspections and construction-phase services, including responding to requests for information (RFIs), reviewing contractor submissions and assisting with design clarifications.
- Ensure engineering work complies with relevant Australian Standards, applicable codes, approval conditions and project quality procedures.
- Manage allocated tasks and project deliverables to meet agreed scope, programme, budget and quality requirements.
- Contribute to multidisciplinary project teams and coordinate interfaces with structural, geotechnical, environmental and other engineering disciplines.
- Assist with fee proposals, tenders and technical submissions, and contribute to client relationships and business development under appropriate supervision.
About you
- A degree in Civil Engineering or an equivalent recognised qualification.
- 3–5 years of post-graduate experience in civil engineering.
- Demonstrated experience in civil engineering design, analysis and preparation of engineering documentation relevant to the role.
- Sound understanding of civil engineering principles and the ability to prepare and check calculations using appropriate engineering methods and software.
- Experience with relevant design tools and software used for civil engineering projects; familiarity with commonly used CAD, modelling or drainage design packages is advantageous.
- Understanding of applicable Australian Standards, codes, authority requirements and Australian engineering practices relevant to the work.
- Ability to interpret survey data, plans, specifications and technical reports and apply them to engineering design.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently when required and contribute effectively within a project team.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, a proactive approach and high attention to detail.
- Relevant professional accreditation or registration, or working towards it, is desirable.

About us
PD Project Delivery (PDPD) is a Brisbane civil engineering consultancy. We support clients with project management, engineering and supervision on major infrastructure projects across Queensland, from data centres and rail to energy and civil works. Our small head office team supports our people on site, so you can get on with the job.
About the opportunity
We're looking for Civil Engineers to join a large-scale data centre project in Queensland.
Data centres are the infrastructure behind cloud computing and AI, and they're being built quickly. This is your chance to put a high-profile, technically demanding project on your CV and work with a strong site team from the early stages of the build.
The point of hire is Brisbane. The role is bus-in/bus-out on a 15 days on, 6 days off roster.

About the role:
This role focuses on the technical delivery of drainage and stormwater design, with opportunities to contribute to flood resilience, water sensitive urban design, water quality and waterway management. You will provide technical advice and support to project managers and team leaders to meet project and client requirements. Appointment at Senior Engineer level may be considered depending on your experience and technical capability.

- Undertake MUSIC modelling and design stormwater-quality measures.

- Interaction with clients in order to nurture long lasting relationships.

•    Working closely with Engineers and Inspectors to ensure accurate field records and agreed measurements are available to support the assessment of progress claims, variations and extension of time claims.

Site Engineer
Major Energy Project 
Sydney to Dubbo
 $100k - $130k + Super + LAFHA
 We’re a Sydney-based civil contractor looking for a Site Engineer to join our team on a new major energy project in Dubbo, NSW. 
 Key responsibilities
 - Coordinate and oversee day-to-day civil construction activities
 - Prepare and review ITPs, SWMS and work packages
 - Manage quality, safety and compliance on site
 - Coordinate concrete pours, inspections and hold points
 - Track quantities, progress and variations
 - Liaise with subcontractors, suppliers and the client’s representatives
 - Maintain site records, diaries and as-built documentation

 - Degree in civil engineering (or equivalent experience)
 - Site-based experience in civil construction, ideally on energy, substation or heavy civil projects
 - Practical knowledge of FRP form, reo and concrete works
 - Any experience in cables or conduits is highly advantageous 
 - A strong safety mindset and a hands-on approach
 - Good communication and organisation skills
 - Current driver’s licence, and a White Card (other site tickets are welcome)
 What we offer
 - Salary: up to $130k including LAFHA, depending on experience
 - Accommodation: provided at camp, with meals included
 - Transport: provided on site (you’ll need to arrange your own travel to and from Sydney or your point of origin)

 - A supportive team and the chance to work on a high-profile project

 If you would be interested in finding out more information please click "Apply" and forward your updated resume. Alternatively, call our Business Lead, Kyle for a confidential chat on 0482 096 006.

candidates.content_text:
Our Company:
UDEC Pty Ltd (UDEC) (Utilities, Design, Engineering, Construction) is an engineering consultancy with specialist experience in utility engineering services. UDEC provides design and coordination engineering services to our Clients with a focus on the delivery of major water and transport infrastructure projects. Our personnel have provided professional, cost-effective services to some of the largest construction projects in Australia, that include Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane and Gold Coast regions. 
UDEC has built up a reputation as an experienced and effective team with advanced capabilities, fulfilling the needs of our Clients, in the fields of major water and sewage, electricity, telecommunications and gas co-ordination/relocations.
About the Role:
We are expanding our drafting capability in our Victoria / Queensland offices. UDEC is seeking an experienced Civil Engineering Draftsperson (Drafter) to produce construction-ready documentation for major infrastructure projects across Australia. The Drafter role forms part of the Drafting team and assists in transforming engineering concepts into precise technical drawings whilst achieving quality documentation. The Drafter is responsible for assisting Civil Engineering Professionals with drawing production on projects, and contributing to continuous improvement of company CAD systems
This is a full-time position with UDEC based in our UDEC office, reporting to the CADD Manager National.
UDEC is looking for a highly motivated individual with a keen interest in developing and broadening their skills and experience in the Public Utilities, Water and Wastewater Industry within an engineering company with a primary focus on major infrastructure projects across Australia.
Duties and Responsibilities:
- Effective utilisation of computer-aided design and drafting software applications applicable to utility infrastructure design
- Assist in undertaking various planning and design activities for utility projects to achieve successful completion within time, quality, cost and stakeholder expectations
- Coordinate design with other disciplines
- Identify project scope and programme requirements to carry out the work, specific to each job being undertaken
- Develop and produce technical drawings as required by the Project Manager, Engineers, Designers using CAD, digital graphics and desktop publishing computer systems
- Undertake engineering modelling and drafting works
- Identify requirements to carry out the work
- Ongoing continual professional development and familiarity with relevant codes, regulations and industry standards
- Adherence to UDEC Quality Management System project requirements including CAD requirements
What We Look For:
Experience
- 2+ years of relevant experience in preparing drawings for civil infrastructure projects using 2D drafting software within an Australian Consultancy
Software skills
- Proficient in AutoCAD (2D production and sheet set management)
- Proficient in the use of Synergy
- Software customisation, script authoring, etc.
Qualifications
- Tertiary education in relevant discipline 
Technical Knowledge
- Strong understanding of CAD standards, civil drafting conventions, standard symbols and presentation guidelines across various Australian states
- Solid working knowledge of relevant Australian Standards and State Government drafting requirements
Delivery
- Ability to prioritise and prepare drawings for civil infrastructure projects and deliver to deadlines
Communication
- Excellent verbal and written skills
- Skilled at collaborative working, have good interpersonal skills and an ability to communicate effectively
Additional features of the role (travel or physical requirements): 
- Generally based at UDEC Melbourne or Brisbane office but may be required to work from dedicated Major Projects offices as required for project delivery.
Our People:
Our people are our number one asset, and we are committed to providing a workplace that supports our team to grow.
UDEC personnel have worked together to build an industry reputation as a cohesive, experienced and effective team, valued for their contribution in delivering successful projects to our clients and ensure that there is no compromise on the quality we deliver.
What We Offer:
- A genuine career role for an experienced and enthusiastic Drafter looking to continue to develop their professional experience within the major infrastructure project environment;
- Clear career progression paths into design management or principal technical roles;
- Opportunity to work across a diverse range of challenging projects;
- Flexible working arrangements will be considered by mutual agreement and according to operational requirements;
- An attractive remuneration package commensurate with experience;
- Vibrant team culture with a dynamic and highly skilled team;
- Strong organisational values with a work/life balance; and
- Employee opportunities, training and career progression.
UDEC is committed to Equal Employment Opportunities and invites applications from people of all nationalities, genders, and cultural backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islanders.
How to apply:
To learn more about what we do, go to: http://www.udec.com.au/ 
If you are interested in becoming part of the UDEC team and believe you meet the criteria, apply via email to: recruitment@udec.com.au
Applications close Friday 20 November 2026 at 5pm (AEDT).
Your application should include a Covering Letter addressing how you meet the above criteria and your Resume outlining your experience.

candidates.content_text:
About the project 
At Laing O’Rourke, you won’t just build projects, you’ll help shape the future. As a $6 billion privately owned global engineering and manufacturing-led construction leader, we deliver some of the nation’s most complex infrastructure, from transport networks to defence and utilities.  
Be part of Australia’s largest-ever defence infrastructure program.
Laing O’Rourke, with joint venture partner Amentum Australia, will play a central role in supporting Australian Naval Infrastructure (ANI) to develop and deliver the Nuclear-Powered Submarine Construction Yard (NPSCY) project at Osborne, South Australia. We will provide program and construction management services of nuclear related civil infrastructure, site‑wide nuclear licensee development expertise, and nuclear safety leadership. 
Benefits 
At Laing O’Rourke, we’re committed to helping our people thrive and build meaningful, rewarding careers. We offer exceptional development opportunities, wellbeing support and a range of benefits designed to support you both at work and beyond. 
We’re proud to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcome applications from First Nations Peoples and people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds. Laing O’Rourke is also recognised by the Workplace Gender Equality Agency (WGEA) as an Employer of Choice for Gender Equality. 
Some of our benefits include: 
- In-house training and on-the-job development opportunities 
- Six months’ paid parental leave at full pay for all employees 
- Purchased leave options and volunteering leave 
- Exclusive discounts and savings across hundreds of Australian retailers 
Learn more about our Benefits & Rewards and our Stretch Reconciliation Action Plan   https://www.laingorourke.com/company/diversity-and-inclusion 
We are currently seeking a Site Engineer to join our AUKUS team. 
Key Responsibilities
- Manage subcontractor packages, contractor performance and project interfaces.
- Coordinate planning, scheduling and delivery against project milestones.
- Review designs, technical requirements and manage RFIs through to closeout.
- Maintain project records, engineering systems and digital engineering tools.
- Build strong stakeholder relationships and support continuous development.
About You
- A minimum of 2 years’ construction/engineering project experience
- An understanding of design, specifications, managing subcontractors, providing technical direction, issue resolution, providing quality assurance, producing site reports.
- Degree in Engineering (Civil/Mechanical/Electrical) or Construction Management or equivalent.
- Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be able to obtain an Australian Defence Security Clearance to NV1 level.
If you’re ready to do meaningful and career-defining work that leaves a lasting impact on communities for generations, apply today.
